explication: EngineWire is an Unreal Editor MCP server: an AI client issues a capability request, which reaches the editor either over native HTTP or through the restart-resilient Node.js stdio proxy; the plugin executes editor work and returns a response. The plugin also exposes broad authoring and asset-management domains, with TypeScript capability records describing the single `unreal` tool. The README documents the overall routes and product capabilities; source excerpts show proxy behavior and parts of the native request/response path, but not every domain handler or transport implementation.
